contexts.text: Moses, Aaron, and Hur () = Divine truths in successive order... Hur = Divine truth again mediately proceeding through this. Explained. AC 8611.

And Aaron and Hur with you () = the doctrine of truth from such a Word... Hur, when joined to Aaron, = the truth of that doctrine; as also does Hur, when together with Aaron he supported the hands of Moses.
That by Hur is represented the doctrine of truth. References.
